title: Building MEV-Resistant DeFi: A Practitioner's Guide to Protecting Protocols and Users From Value Extraction

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How can DeFi protocols defend against MEV while preserving decentralization and user trust?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Zero-knowledge proofs and on-chain auctions help, but MEV bots still exploit front-running in Ethereum's mempool.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If protocols prioritize speed over fairness, they risk alienating users and reinforcing systemic inequalities in financial access.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Some projects use off-chain relay systems and blockspace auctions to reduce frontrunning and distribute value more equitably.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where DeFi is both efficient and ethical could emerge through transparent, inclusive governance and fair transaction ordering.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of DeFi lies in balancing innovation with integrity — a challenge that demands both technical and ethical leadership.

video_cue: A decentralized network of nodes processing transactions with glowing blue lines representing fair value distribution.
